name: Waddical
ability: Swift Swim / Slush Rush / Water Veil (hidden)
look: a tall sleek navy penguin with a white belly, olive-gold bands on its flippers and legs, a long hooked beak, goggles pushed up on its forehead and a see-through surfboard under one flipper
entry: It rides the freezing waves on a board of clear ice it carves itself, faster than any boat. The more dangerous the swell, the louder it whoops.
how: Wild: rare on snowy beaches and frozen oceans.
